source: docs/html-ui/phase-1-integration.md §3 and §5; docs/mcp/guide/html-ui.md; docs/html-ui/phase-4-agent-tooling.md section5.4 reviewed example fresh-start determinism (24 channel tolerance, zero mismatching pixels); independently reproduced font atlas edge-sampling regression.; Rml preformatted line-feed handling and the historical missing-glyph-box regression formerly in ControlCharactersTakeNoSpaceAndDrawNothing.
bug: Linear clamp sampling repeated nonzero first-glyph edge texels at the atlas page boundary; different prior glyph populations changed identical text pixels. Actual public GPU probe fails old owner (49 pixels exceed24, maximum26) and passes corrected owner (maximum0). Original alpha/gradient/golden assertions still catch incorrect opacity composition.
oracle: Literal authored fixture colors and committed visual reference, plus independently specified invariance of an identical H glyph to prior unrelated W text. GPU readback must remain within the preexisting reviewed24-channel tolerance; expected images are not computed from renderer code or allocator coordinates.
seam: Public RmlUi document load/render/close boundary and actual GPU screen readback through RenderTestContext; no private font atlas coordinates, cache counts or allocation shape asserted.
refactor: Works with any font allocation, batching or renderer implementation preserving public text pixels. Does not inspect generated UVs or internal call order.
unique: Owns actual font-pixel invariance under changed prior text population at fractional scaling. CPU font metrics/recorded meshes cannot detect texture sampling; retained E2E workflows additionally own their distinct script reset and interaction contracts. Survives consolidation of the historical line-feed rendering regression: actualH and H+LF must have identical pixels, while the width adapter separately asserts LF0.
reason: Strengthened the existing public GPU opacity/glyph owner instead of adding a test case or keeping a private packing assertion. The old implementation is demonstrably rejected and the minimal transparent-border repair passes. The unchanged opacity/golden checks retain their independent source. Historical control-character rendering assertion is now real GPU output rather than private quad counts.
validation: HTMLUI_TEST_ARGS='--gtest_filter=RmlRendererP1GoldenTest.OpacityText' tools/build.sh htmlui-tests; temporary actual GPU old/new probe /tmp/font-history-probe-{old,new}.json
risk: Adds two tiny render contexts and a few real GPU frames, about0.2s in the focused probe. No test-only production seam; full integrated native validation remains required.
